name: forest-adventure
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: a polished landscape 3:2 chapter-card illustration for a Korean sixth-grader's beginner Japanese kanji adventure learning game.
Style/medium: premium playful adventure-game storybook art, crisp friendly rounded shapes, flat-to-soft dimensional shading, clean saturated colors, restrained fine texture, visually polished and suitable for a 12-year-old, not babyish.
Subject design: one original charming small orange fox explorer, upright, large triangular orange ears with dark tips, ivory muzzle and chest, confident curious black eyes, large fluffy orange tail with ivory tip, small leaf-green explorer backpack with golden-yellow straps. No clothing needed.
Palette: emerald and leaf greens with golden-yellow accents; warm orange fox.
Composition: single full-bleed wide landscape scene, large clear silhouette of fox, beautifully composed layered environment, readable at small thumbnail size, key subjects in central safe area.
Constraints: absolutely no text, words, letters, kanji, numbers, logos, watermarks, UI, grids, collages, frames or existing-IP characters.
Scene/backdrop: The fox stands beside a gently flowing turquoise river in a lush broadleaf forest, looking toward a distant mountain with exactly three broad peaks. Broad emerald leaves frame the scene, golden sunlight filters through the trees, smooth river rocks and a simple grassy riverbank. Bright inviting daylight, optimistic sense of beginning an adventure. Fox and river foreground, three-peaked mountain clearly visible beyond.
